sources.claims: Complete competitive ledger; league start and cup eliminations.
Liverpool 1–2 Manchester United: First Anfield match after Hillsborough Independent Panel report; tributes, Gerrard goal and ten-man defeat.
Norwich City 2–5 Liverpool: Second successive Carrow Road hat-trick and first league win of Rodgers era.
Oldham Athletic 3–2 Liverpool: League One opponents eliminate Liverpool in fourth round.
Liverpool 3–1 Zenit Saint Petersburg: Two Suárez free-kicks drive recovery which falls short on away goals.
Liverpool 2–2 Chelsea: Late equaliser is inseparable from Ivanović biting incident and subsequent ten-match ban.
Newcastle United 0–6 Liverpool: Joint-best Premier League away win at the time, first match of Suárez suspension, new attack prominent.
Liverpool 1–0 Queens Park Rangers: Carragher’s 737th and final appearance, Coutinho goal decides season finale.
Primary written disciplinary reasons; 65th-minute biting incident and admitted violent conduct.

deliberateOmissions: Opening West Bromwich Albion defeat: managerial debut alone does not warrant a report; the difficult start is context for Norwich first league victory.
Young Boys 5–3 and Udinese qualification: European season adequately represented by Zenit deciding leg; avoid treating every entertaining group match as indispensable.
Mansfield debut and handball controversy: Oldham is more consequential cup outcome; Sturridge’s arrival belongs in Newcastle context.
Tottenham 3–2, Swansea 5–0 and Fulham Sturridge hat-trick: considered, but Newcastle gives the strongest account of the developing Sturridge/Coutinho attack.
limitations: Oldham Athletic and Zenit Saint Petersburg opposition IDs absent and require root resolution.
Keep Hillsborough facts anchored in what was known in September 2012; do not imply later inquest findings were already delivered or that campaigning ended.
Suárez disciplinary incident must be reported plainly and not minimised; suspension covered domestic matches across two seasons.
Detailed match-specific and independent checks still required before prose. No manuscripts drafted.
